mapper.select: SELECT coalesce(family_root_id, id) FROM theme_draft WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM theme_draft WHERE family_root_id = #{root} AND status = 'GENERATING')
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM theme_draft WHERE (family_root_id = #{root} OR id = #{root}) AND status = 'ADOPTED')

SELECT d.id, d.status, d.created_at, d.output->'images'->>#{scene} AS image, d.output->'videos'->>#{scene} AS video, d.output->'motions'->#{scene} AS motion, coalesce(n.starred,false) AS starred, coalesce(n.note,'') AS note FROM theme_draft d LEFT JOIN theme_draft_scene_note n ON n.version_id = d.id AND n.scene = #{scene} WHERE d.output IS NOT NULL AND d.status != 'GENERATING' AND (d.id = #{root} OR (d.family_root_id = #{root} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(d.input #> '{regenerate,targets}') AS t(target) WHERE split_part(t.target, ':', 2) = #{scene}))) ORDER BY (d.id = #{root}) DESC, d.created_at, d.id

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(id,parent,depth) AS ( SELECT id, input #>> '{regenerate,baseDraftId}', 0 FROM theme_draft WHERE id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT d.id, d.input #>> '{regenerate,baseDraftId}', a.depth + 1 FROM ancestors a JOIN theme_draft d ON d.id::text = a.parent ) SELECT id FROM ancestors ORDER BY depth

SELECT s.scene, s.version_id FROM theme_draft d JOIN theme_draft_scene_selection s ON s.root_id = coalesce(d.family_root_id,d.id) WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.status NOT IN ('ADOPTED','DISCARDED') UNION ALL SELECT e.key AS scene, e.value::uuid AS version_id FROM theme_draft d CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(d.frozen_scene_choices) e WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.status IN ('ADOPTED','DISCARDED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO theme_draft_scene_selection (root_id, scene, version_id, reviewed_version_ids, confirmed_at) VALUES (#{root}, #{scene}, #{version}, ARRAY[#{id}]::uuid[], clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT (root_id, scene) DO UPDATE SET version_id = excluded.version_id, reviewed_version_ids = excluded.reviewed_version_ids, confirmed_at = excluded.confirmed_at

INSERT INTO theme_draft_scene_note (version_id, scene, starred, note) VALUES (#{version}, #{scene}, coalesce(#{starred,jdbcType=BOOLEAN},false), coalesce(#{note,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'')) ON CONFLICT (version_id, scene) DO UPDATE SET starred = coalesce(#{starred,jdbcType=BOOLEAN},theme_draft_scene_note.starred), note = coalesce(#{note,jdbcType=VARCHAR},theme_draft_scene_note.note)
